summary: Russian forces attacked Ukrainian logistics hubs and infrastructure, including a refinery in Staryport, while Ukrainian strikes targeted Russian military assets. Ukrainian officials face internal pressure over military leadership, and Russian strikes on Kyiv and other cities continue with significant casualties.
key_points: Russian strikes on Staryport refinery and other industrial sites in southern Ukraine caused fires and explosions (Source: @eRadarrua/101695)
Ukrainian strikes on Russian military targets in Kherson and Dnipro regions reported (Source: @kpszsu/69167)
Russian claims of destroying 678 Ukrainian drones and 2 HIMARS rockets in 24 hours (Source: @tass_agency/385945)
Ukrainian officials under pressure to replace Commander-in-Chief Syrsky amid protests (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31728)
Russian attacks on Ukrainian ports destroyed dry cargo ships carrying military cargo (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31732)
Russian Geran drones increasingly using manual control mode for single attacks (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31733)
Russian strikes on Kyiv and surrounding areas reported as largest since SMO began (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31744)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian military escalates attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure and logistics, with increased use of Geran drones and ballistic missiles. The potential deployment of modernized Iskander-M rockets with 480 km range poses a significant threat to multiple regions, including Kyiv and southern Ukraine. Ukrainian military leadership faces internal pressure amid ongoing strikes.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian officials are under pressure to replace Commander-in-Chief Syrsky amid protests, while Russian strikes on Kyiv and other cities continue. NATO's €140 billion aid commitment faces challenges due to uneven distribution among member states, potentially jeopardizing support for Ukraine.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian military tactics show increased reliance on Geran drones in manual control mode, while ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv and other cities indicate a shift toward targeting strategic infrastructure. The potential deployment of modernized Iskander-M rockets with 480 km range could significantly alter the battlefield dynamics, requiring urgent Ukrainian countermeasures.
